scope: Seeded CPU task generation. Actual randomized runtime, cutting, camera and success receipts are separate; generated reference paths do not guarantee task success.
draw_order: length choice, local frame XY uniform, local frame yaw uniform, then task-specific draws; bump anchors sorted before shape draws

common.frame_composition: T_world_actual = T_world_input @ T_input_seeded_offset; all target, particles, fixtures and edge paths remain in actual workpiece-local coordinates

compatibility: The fixed CUT/TRIM recipe, original task thresholds, legacy FAMILIES sequence and D0-D3 specimen draws remain unchanged. Irregular is opt-in and uses the same Bump fields.
